purpose: Teach: プライス/デイリー/タイムリー/コントラスト/不合格/日本経済新聞/レジスト/博覧

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、商品プライスを再検討しろ
lines.en: We need to revisit our product pricing strategy.
lines.style: Clipped, commanding tone. No warmth. Direct eye contact. Authority that expects immediate comprehension and action. Efficient breath control—no filler.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。デイリーの売上集計を提出します
lines.en: Yes. I'll prepare the daily sales totals for review.
lines.style: Respectful, measured cadence. Slightly deferential nod in the voice—acknowledging the instruction. Professional and controlled. No volunteered opinion, just competent agreement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、タイムリーなキャンペーンを打て
lines.en: Launch a timely campaign. We need market presence now.
lines.style: Sharp attack on the opening. Imperative but not harsh. Slight emphasis on 'now'—conveying urgency without raising volume. Lean forward in posture, eyes steady.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広告のコントラストを強くします
lines.en: Understood. I'll strengthen the contrast in our advertising materials.
lines.style: Steady, professional delivery. Slight uptick at the end—signaling readiness to execute. No hesitation. Clear syllables. Shows he's already thinking through the implementation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 検査不合格品の流通を止めろ
lines.en: Stop the distribution of any inspection-failed products immediately.
lines.style: Clipped, no negotiation. Slight drop in pitch on 'immediately'—absolute finality. Composed but the subtext is serious. Brief pause before the final word for weight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。日本経済新聞のインタビューを受けます
lines.en: Yes. I'll coordinate with media and arrange the Nikkei interview.
lines.style: Rapid-fire, efficient. Shows he's already processing next steps. Professional tone—not defensive about the unusual task pairing. Breathes after the comma, moving forward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、特許のレジスト技術を磨け
lines.en: Refine our resist technology in the patent portfolio. That's our edge.
lines.style: Quieter than previous commands. Weight on 'edge'—this is strategic, not just operational. Leans back slightly. A moment of genuine belief in what he's saying, beneath the authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。万国博覧会へのブース出展を準備します
lines.en: Yes. I'll prepare our booth presence for the international exposition.
lines.style: Concluding tone—slightly fuller breath than before. Respectful, but this feels like the conversation's natural end. Calm professionalism. A small nod of understanding, delivered in the voice.
